title: The Mainframe Product must disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
check_content:
Verify the Mainframe Product is configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.

If the Mainframe Product is not configured to disable accounts when the accounts have expired, this is a finding.
fixtext: Configure the Mainframe Product to disable accounts when the accounts have expired.
VulnDiscussion: Disabling expired, inactive, or otherwise anomalous accounts supports the concepts of least privilege and least functionality which reduce the attack surface of the system.
